ImageDescription.value: Photo from the Valbonë Valley National Park The Qafa e Valbonës, or Valbona pass in Albania connects the town of Theth, located at Theth National Park in a valley formed by the Shalë river with the town of Valbonë in Valbonë Valley National Park. This photograph was taken in October 2013 on the Valbona side at about 2/3 of the ascent to the top of the pass. It shows the mountains surrounding Maja Grykat e Hapëta, which is one of the highest mountains of all of Albania.
